2608.29289.title: AOI-Net: Structural Face AOI-Guided Eye-Gaze Track Representation Learning for Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection
2608.29289.paper_summary: Eye-movement tracking has emerged as a promising non-invasive approach to Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) screening, with systematic differences in attentional allocation and revisit behaviors observed during socially interactive tasks. Existing computational methods typically characterize eye-movements using discrete gaze trajectories and fixation events, yielding representations dominated by short-range temporal dynamics and limiting models that primarily emphasize long-range dependencies. Meanwhile, gaze behavior is naturally organized across semantically meaningful Areas of Interest (AOIs), whose attention allocation and transitions provide important structural cues, yet their relationships are rarely modeled explicitly. To address these limitations, we propose a structural face AOI-guided Eye-Gaze Track Network (AOI-Net) that jointly models short-term temporal dynamics and AOI-level structural organization. A network gating mechanism adaptively integrates the complementary temporal and structural representations according to their contributions to gaze-behavior characterization. To mitigate the pronounced class imbalance commonly encountered between individuals with ASD and Typically Developing (TD) participants in clinical datasets, class-distribution-aware learning is further employed to facilitate discriminative embedding learning under skewed class distributions. Experiments on a unique and large-scale clinical eye-tracking database comprising eight stimulus subsets and more than 1,300 participants show that AOI-Net consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The proposed framework also enables interpretable gaze-behavior modeling and provides a practical basis for scalable AI-driven ASD screening in real-world healthcare. The code is available at https://github.com/Zhanpei-ai/CIM-AOI-Net/tree/main/Code
2608.29289.paper_summary_zh: 眼動追蹤已成為自閉症譜系障礙（ASD）篩檢的一種有前景的非侵入性方法，在社交互動任務中觀察到注意力分配和重訪行為的系統性差異。現有的計算方法通常使用離散的注視軌跡和凝視事件來描述眼動，產生的表徵主要受短期時間動態的主導，限制了主要強調長期依賴性的模型。與此同時，凝視行為自然地在語義上有意義的關注區域（AOIs）中組織，其注意力分配和轉換提供了重要的結構線索，但這些關係很少被明確建模。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一種結構性面部AOI引導的眼動追蹤網絡（AOI-Net），該網絡聯合建模短期時間動態和AOI級別的結構組織。一個網絡閘控機制根據其對凝視行為特徵化的貢獻，自適應地整合互補的時間和結構表徵。為了減輕臨床數據集中自閉症患者與典型發展（TD）參與者之間常見的明顯類別不平衡，進一步採用了類別分佈感知學習，以促進在偏斜類別分佈下的區別性嵌入學習。對一個獨特且大規模的臨床眼動追蹤數據庫進行的實驗，該數據庫包含八個刺激子集和超過1,300名參與者，顯示AOI-Net始終優於最先進的方法。所提出的框架還使得可解釋的凝視行為建模成為可能，並為現實世界醫療中可擴展的AI驅動ASD篩檢提供了實用基礎。代碼可在 https://github.com/Zhanpei-ai/CIM-AOI-Net/tree/main/Code 獲得。
